classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

assumptions: The user intends to query a specific GO term related to NAD(P)HX repair (e.g., GO:0004600 for NADH dehydrogenase or similar), but the exact ID was not provided in the request.
The workflow will proceed using a placeholder GO ID that must be replaced by the user before execution.
Sequence analysis will be performed at physiological pH (7.4) unless specified otherwise.
The ranking will rely on sequence composition, charge, and motif presence as no structural data is available.
plan.goal: Retrieve representative protein sequences for NAD(P)HX repair enzymes using a GO term, analyze their biochemical properties, and rank the top candidates based on sequence features.
missing_inputs: GO term ID for NAD(P)HX repair proteins (e.g., GO:0004600, GO:0004601, etc.)

success_criteria.goal: Produce a ranked list of 10 representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins with analysis metrics.
